title: Lord Of The Flips
tagline: A smart agent that plays Flippando, suggests best art creations, manages $FLIPND arbitrage across chains and tweets about it.
description: Lord Of The Flips is a smart agent that can play an on-chain game called Flippando. It can start games, flip tiles, create complex NFTs, and tweet, or post a cast, about these actions. It can also suggest potential art creations, using the existing basic NFTs. It has its own wallet and can observe potential arbitrage opportunities across chains for the game's fungible token, $FLIPND.,
how_its_made: This projects uses or it is inspired by Eliza OS and CDP. The plan is to integrate CDP existing workflows into making the agent autonomously perform the tasks described in the project goals. I started by forking coinbase/agentkit and gradually build on top of it, by creating specific workflows for playing Flippando.
